responsibility: Declares the pattern-lowering visitor used by the Rust front end to convert AST::Pattern trees into HIR::Pattern nodes. The ASTLoweringPattern class defines overrides for the major Rust pattern forms—identifier, literal, wildcard, tuple, tuple-struct, struct, range, grouped, reference, and expression-path patterns—and exposes a single translate entry point that other lowerers use for let bindings, match arms, function parameters, and loop patterns.
same_name_distinction: Declares the ASTLoweringPattern visitor and its translate entry point for pattern AST nodes, whereas rust-ast-lower-pattern.cc contains the lowering logic for identifier, tuple, struct, range, reference, and related pattern forms.
